FX-ADDGRAIN-001.says: The settings as they start: intensity 1, size 1, Film, in colour, a new grain every frame; every shown pixel moves by up to 0.1 a channel through the sRGB curve, most in the middle of each channel, nothing in the white and black patches; the empty pixels stay empty and the soft edge keeps its half covering.

FX-ADDGRAIN-002.says: Animation Speed 0: the same grain on frames 0, 2 and 4, FX-ADDGRAIN-001's frame 0.

FX-ADDGRAIN-003.says: Animation Speed 0.5, smooth: frame 1 is half way between FX-ADDGRAIN-001's frames 0 and 1 in the noise, and frame 2 is its frame 1.

FX-ADDGRAIN-004.says: Animation Speed 0.5, Animate Smoothly off: frame 1 holds frame 0's grain and frame 3 is FX-ADDGRAIN-001's frame 1.

FX-ADDGRAIN-005.says: Monochromatic, Add: the three channels move together, a grey grain.

FX-ADDGRAIN-006.says: Saturation 0, Add: each channel takes the three's mean, so they move together, but less than FX-ADDGRAIN-005's.

FX-ADDGRAIN-008.says: Size 4, Add: grains of 4 by 4 pixels, each one number.

FX-ADDGRAIN-009.says: Size 4, Softness 1, Add: the grains blend smoothly into each other.

FX-ADDGRAIN-010.says: Size 4, Softness 0.5, Add: half way between FX-ADDGRAIN-008 and 009 in the noise.

FX-ADDGRAIN-011.says: Size 2, Aspect Ratio 2, Add: grains 4 across and 2 down.

FX-ADDGRAIN-012.says: Channel intensities 2, 0 and 0.5, Add: red's grain doubled, green untouched, blue's halved.

FX-ADDGRAIN-013.says: Shadows 0, Highlights 0, Add: no grain in the black or the white patch, and most in the middle tones.

FX-ADDGRAIN-014.says: Shadows 3, Midtones 0, Highlights 0.5, Midpoint 0.3, Add: strong grain in the dark line, none at brightness 0.3.

FX-ADDGRAIN-015.says: Add, intensity 3: the white patch can only darken and the black only lighten; elsewhere up to 0.3 either way.

FX-ADDGRAIN-016.says: Overlay, intensity 2: the grain laid on in Overlay.

FX-ADDGRAIN-018.says: Intensity 10, Add: the grain at its strongest.

FX-ADDGRAIN-019.says: Random Seed 7: a different grain from FX-ADDGRAIN-001's.

FX-ADDGRAIN-021.says: Random Seed 3.7: its whole part counts, so this is FX-ADDGRAIN-020.

FX-ADDGRAIN-022.says: Intensity keyed from 0 at frame 0 to 4 at frame 4, speed 0, Add: frame 0 is the drawing; frame 4's grain is frame 2's, twice as strong.

FX-ADDGRAIN-023.says: Size keyed from 1 at frame 0 to 5 at frame 4, speed 0: frame 2 is size 3.

FX-ADDGRAIN-024.says: FX-ADDGRAIN-001 moved three pixels right: the grain is the drawing's own, so it moves with it.

FX-ADDGRAIN-025.says: After a Motion Tile that grows the layer: the grain is worked in the drawing's own pixels, so the frame is FX-ADDGRAIN-001's.

FX-ADDGRAIN-026.says: Animation Speed 2: frame 1 is FX-ADDGRAIN-001's frame 2.

FX-ADDGRAIN-027.says: Midpoint keyed from 0.2 at frame 0 to 0.8 at frame 4 with Shadows 0 and Highlights 2, speed 0, Add: the dark tones gain grain as the midpoint rises.

FX-ADDGRAIN-028.says: Monochromatic, Size 3, Softness 0.3, Aspect 0.5, Film, intensity 2, speed 0.25 smooth, seed 11: the controls together.

FX-ADDGRAIN-029.says: Intensity 11, above 10. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-ADDGRAIN-030.says: Size 0.05, below 0.1. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-ADDGRAIN-031.says: Softness 1.5, above 1. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-ADDGRAIN-032.says: Aspect Ratio 5, above 4. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-ADDGRAIN-033.says: Green Intensity -1, below 0. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-ADDGRAIN-034.says: Saturation 2, above 1. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-ADDGRAIN-035.says: Midpoint 1, above 0.99. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-ADDGRAIN-036.says: Animation Speed 11, above 10. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-ADDGRAIN-037.says: Random Seed 100001, above 100000. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-ADDGRAIN-038.says: Blending Mode "screen", not one of its three words. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-ADDGRAIN-039.says: Monochromatic "yes", not off or on. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-ADDGRAIN-040.says: Animate Smoothly "On", in capitals, kept as written and not the word. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-ADDGRAIN-041.says: Shadows keyed to 20 at frame 4, above 10. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.
